job.title: Senior IT Manager Digital Platforms & Enterprise Applications (m/w/d)
job.email_subject: Application: Senior IT Manager Digital Platforms – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your role needs someone who keeps digital platforms and enterprise applications working as one – my focus for 5+ years across e-commerce, ERP and PIM at Rockwell Automation and Shell. What I bring in concrete terms:

– E-commerce platform delivery and releases
– SAP ERP / PIM / MDM integration with international teams
– Requirements, stakeholder alignment and technical guidance

This lets me take on real responsibility in your team from day one. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I am happy to walk you through my projects in detail. Could we set up a short 15-minute call in the next few days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Digital Platforms & Enterprise Applications | E-Commerce, ERP Integration & Delivery
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional digital platforms professional with 5+ years on enterprise e-commerce and application landscapes (SAP Commerce Cloud, SAP ERP, PIM, MDM) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Connects business and IT through requirements engineering, stakeholder management, solution design, process mapping and UAT, backed by hands-on technical depth in integrations, APIs, CI/CD deployment cycles and production support. Guides junior developers, works agile with PI Planning, Jira and Confluence in international teams and uses AI tools extensively across analysis and delivery.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Severin is a family-owned brand for household appliances that sells across many channels, where digital platforms and enterprise applications must work hand in hand. I want to bring my integration-focused e-commerce experience to a company where IT directly supports a well-known product brand. My combination of hands-on platform depth and close work with business teams is exactly what I want to put to work for you.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, your Senior IT Manager Digital Platforms role caught my eye: 5+ years e-commerce platforms with SAP ERP/PIM/MDM integration, techno-functional (Rockwell Automation, Shell). Karlsruhe, start 16.12.2026. Open to a short call?

en.subject: Application: Senior IT Manager Digital Platforms & Enterprise Applications
en.hook: Digital platforms and enterprise applications only create value when e-commerce, ERP and product data work as one landscape. That integrated view is what I bring: for more than five years at Rockwell Automation and Shell I have worked on large commerce platforms and their ERP, PIM and MDM integrations – between business stakeholders and technical teams.

bullets.label: Digital platforms
bullets.text: Designed and implemented functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud for product, catalog, pricing and customer data and executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds.

bullets.label: Enterprise application integration
bullets.text: Resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international teams and built PIM data pipelines across global channels.

bullets.label: Business alignment
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications and supported UAT.

bullets.label: Stability & guidance
bullets.text: Engineered API migrations improving system stability, supported production issues and provided technical guidance to junior developers.

en.logistics: I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a conversation about how I can support Severin's digital platforms.
